title: RT Label and Closed-Triad Classification Explicitness
purpose: Make the governed meaning of the token RT explicit by distinguishing the RT label from the canonical RT_core whole-expression binding without rewriting the foundational calculus or silently promoting downstream interpretations.
summary: RT means Real Truth. Under this patch, RT is the classificatory label applied to an admissibly closed triad at the resolved scope of that closure. The canonical root expression RT := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)] remains the governed foundational RT_core binding and is treated as a foundational instance of RT rather than as proof that the token RT is itself an operator, process, or substance.

basis.scope: Additive semantic clarification for the meaning of RT across governed usage, while preserving the existing RT_core binding and classifying unresolved downstream wording conflicts instead of silently rewriting them.

core_rule.statement: RT expands to Real Truth. RT is a classification label applied to an admissibly closed triad at the resolved scope of that closure. The token RT does not itself perform closure, distinction, projection, or indexing, and the canonical whole-expression binding RT := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)] remains the governed foundational RT_core instance of that classification.

RT.definition: The classification label assigned to an admissibly closed triad.

RT_core.definition: The canonical foundational whole-expression binding RT := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)] consumed by the live semantic authority runtime.
RT_core.relation_to_RT: RT_core is a foundational governed instance of RT at its declared closure scope.

closure_basis.definition: The governing admissibility or closure rule that licenses RT classification for the triad under consideration.

rt_index.definition: A manipulable representation or identifier of an RT under a declared reference and observation schema; the index is not identical to the complete RT it represents.

semantic_invariants.rule: RT always expands to Real Truth.
RT is a classification label, not an operator.
RT is not itself a process or substance.
Any admissibly closed triad may be classified as RT at its resolved scope.
RT_core remains the canonical foundational whole-expression binding and is not displaced by this clarification.
A higher-order closed triad may be classified as RT without erasing the RT status of component closures at their own scopes.
Closure licenses RT classification; the token RT does not perform closure.
Scope-relative completeness of an RT must not be silently inflated into omniscient or globally exhaustive truth.

preserved: RT := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)] remains the canonical runtime-facing RT_core binding.
RT-governed primitive and derived expressions remain traceable to RT_core.
Departmental inheritance of RT/Core remains intact.
prohibited_readings: RT is a privileged substance distinct from the closed relation it labels.
A finite index is identical to the complete RT it indexes.
forward_review_required: Legacy or provisional surfaces that name RT as a process.
Surfaces that define RT only as a whole expression without distinguishing the RT label from RT_core.
Surfaces that collapse RT identity into an index or representational substrate.

department_inheritance_rule.statement: Departments that inherit RT/Core without locally redefining RT remain compatible by inheritance. Departments and semantic contracts that define RT directly must now preserve the distinction between RT as Real Truth classification and RT_core as the canonical foundational binding.

governed_outputs.role: Canonical authority witness for the RT label clarification.
Cross-surface inventory and classification report for compatible, ambiguous, and conflicting RT usages.

required_repo_changes.description: Clarify that the runtime-facing canonical expression is the RT_core binding and a governed instance of the RT classification.
Add a governed clarification that distinguishes the RT label from the RT_core whole-expression binding.
Add the canonical semantic authority witness for the RT label clarification.
Add the governed compliance inventory identifying compatible-by-inheritance, ambiguous, and conflicting RT usages.
Register the new RT semantic authority surfaces and patch record by hash.
Register the forward RT semantic clarification under additive governance.

success_criteria: RT is explicitly governed as the Real Truth classification label.
The canonical RT_core whole-expression binding remains preserved.
Department inheritance of RT/Core is not broken by the clarification.
Conflicting and ambiguous downstream RT usages are classified for forward review instead of being silently rewritten.

textbook_integration.recommended_location: Chapter 1, immediately after the canonical RT binding block.
textbook_integration.integration_note: Clarify that RT names the Real Truth classification while the displayed root expression is the canonical RT_core binding and a foundational RT at that scope.

governance_notes: This patch is additive and does not rewrite the canonical RT_core expression.
This patch does not silently repair every historical RT usage; it classifies unresolved surfaces for forward review.
Compatibility by inheritance is sufficient for department SSOTs that do not locally redefine RT.
